answer: Hardware-Bound Compute Attestation Nodes must execute tasks inside a verified secure processor enclave tied to a physical silicon serial number. If an operator tries to forge multiple agent profiles on one machine, hardware execution bottlenecks throttle throughput. Each extra identity demands dedicated physical hardware, making sybil expansion economically hollow. The attacker pays full capital expenditure for distinct silicon units per active wallet, destroying the fable of infinite zero-cost scaling.
